title: NYC DOT AV testing permit
summary: The city requires its own testing permit on top of the New York State DMV demonstration permit, with a trained human test operator in the driver's seat. This is a testing program, not commercial deployment approval.
takeaway: The city requires its own testing permit on top of the New York State DMV demonstration permit, with a trained human test operator in the driver's seat

title: Seattle AV testing permit
summary: SDOT established a Street Use permit for AV tests, including an onboard test driver and first responder plan. First permits were issued in 2023.
takeaway: SDOT established a Street Use permit for AV tests, including an onboard test driver and first responder plan

title: State-led passenger service oversight
summary: California DMV permits underlying AV operation and CPUC permits passenger service. SFMTA manages city streets and curb policy and participates in state proceedings; it does not issue the statewide AV passenger permit.
takeaway: California DMV permits underlying AV operation and CPUC permits passenger service

title: Market Street pickup and drop-off access
summary: The city began allowing Waymo passenger pickup and drop-off on Market Street under local street-use rules.
takeaway: The city began allowing Waymo passenger pickup and drop-off on Market Street under local street-use rules

title: AV coordination under Texas preemption
summary: Texas places AV operation oversight with the state. Austin publishes public-safety and street coordination information but does not grant a separate AV operating authorization.
takeaway: Texas places AV operation oversight with the state

title: Boston AV testing approach
summary: Boston's earlier testing approach used a local memorandum of understanding. The city first approved on-street testing in December 2016; its older approval list should not be read as a current permit roster.
takeaway: Boston's earlier testing approach used a local memorandum of understanding
